fileheader.author: hangar
fileheader.description: Chengdu J-20A (hangar build, from public estimates)
fileheader.note: Aerodynamics: vortex lattice with viscous section polars, full-envelope strip model, slender-body fuselage (hangar). Mass: Raymer component weights on the geometry. Propeller: blade-element momentum theory.
